title: Rigidity of the multi-bubble solutions to the energy critical wave equation in dimension five
summary: We study the asymptotic dynamics of multi-bubble solutions to the focusing energy-critical wave equation in five dimensions. Assuming that the solution asymptotically decomposes into a finite superposition of spatially separated bubbles with comparable scales, we prove a rigidity result that describes the precise long-time behavior of these scales.
